mlp.measurement_scope: Fresh process per method; initialization excludes source loading and initial imports. One validation-only warmup. Inference latency includes feature/evidence/policy/caching work of this method; Each method starts with a fresh private E5 disk cache and private retrieval memory cache; the validation warmup primes only one validation pair. Original entity-disjoint test inputs are cold on first inference; repeated profiles within the split may reuse embeddings. Group-ranking timing runs afterward and is warm. RSS is process-lifetime high-water including Python/imports/models/source, not standalone model allocation. Cross-encoder-only scores all pairs in one batched call; rerank scores real candidate pools, mostly size one/two; latency protocols therefore differ and do not establish an architecture speedup.
mlp.limitations: Synthetic/heuristic pair labels, not independent employer relevance. Policy metrics intentionally include conservative evidence/preference gates; raw semantic classifier metrics are separate. No downstream model retraining.

threshold.selection: Existing rule-baseline 0.05..0.95 validation grid, same formula and tie-break

claims: Exploratory synthetic-label measurements only. Natural judged pools are small and cannot validate catalog-scale retrieval or hiring relevance. No unknown pair was invented as a negative, and no final test label selected a threshold or model.

publication.notes: All five methods were rerun with fresh private caches after the final runtime identity safeguards. No model or threshold was selected on test labels. Timing is a single run per method on a shared execution environment; architecture speedups are not established.
